title: InsideEVs - Here's how much range these popular EVs lose in the cold (Recurrent data)
notes: Published 2025-01-15. Recurrent fleet data, 18,000+ US cars, 20 models: at 0 °C (32 °F) cars keep 83 % of their mild-weather range with a heat pump and 75 % without. Model 3 87 % vs 79 %; Model S 88 % vs 77 %. B116 anchors at 0 °C.
